# Moments

> Moments is a QR-based event photo and video sharing platform for weddings, parties, graduations, launches, conferences, and private gatherings.

Canonical website: https://moments-hq.com/
Contact: https://wa.me/212708080301

## What Moments does

- Guests scan an event QR code and upload photos or videos from a browser; no app or account is required.
- Hosts can run a live slideshow that refreshes as guests share new moments.
- Events can be public or protected with a PIN and private invitation link.
- Large uploads are queued, retried, and resumed after connectivity interruptions.
- Guests can react to moments and view crowd-selected highlights.
- Hosts can moderate content, review event analytics, set retention, and export complete or selected albums as ZIP files.

## Privacy and indexing

Individual event galleries, uploaded media, APIs, and the administration area are not intended for search indexing. Public product information is available on the canonical homepage.

## Languages

The application is available in English and French.
